items.title: Charlie Hamilton Interview, 1965-03-21
items.q: So I went out and played with Raymond and different fellows around here.

ctx.x: You didn't play as much. Couldn't play as much.

I was working on a job where I had more security, and because the music, one time you would make it, and one time we didn't. And a lot of times the jobs were going all the town, and I couldn't go all the town. And up until then I went and worked with Cottrell, Oscar Ruzon, a fellow named Joe Phillip, he organized a band after Sidney Desvign. Oh we had a very refined band. And I worked with Hill Hoever Lyric, and I started playing piano again with those guys. And I stayed in the band until Joe Phillips got rid of…
Do you like piano better than band?
